title: Rabbi Tachlifa bar Yaakov
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the old Midrash Tehillim, 114, speaking in the name of Rabbi Yehudah son of Rabbi Simon; Hyman reports that Buber’s Tehillim reads R’ Chalafta bar Yaakov.[^1]

notes.text: The whole OYW Midrash Tehillim 114 paragraph 1 fully writes Rabbi Tachlifa ben Yaakov and Rabbi Yehudah beRabbi Simon, supporting those local full titles. Hyman’s bar form in the heading is retained. OYW is the actual digital version read here; it does not establish the reading of the old printed edition or Buber’s reported Chalafta variant, whose title remains R’ and which has not been freshly collated.
